_comment: ARC TESTNET MANIFEST (chainId 5042002). Sibling of round.json, which is Sepolia. Same schema, read through src/config/deployments.ts, which picks ONE manifest per selected chain. Uniswap v4 did not exist on Arc, so poolManager/positionManager here are contracts WE deployed (contracts/solidity/deploy/DeployV4Core.s.sol), not canonical ones. indexerUrl is deliberately EMPTY: no Ponder instance is deployed for Arc yet, so indexer-backed panels degrade to the IndexerHealthBanner while the 11 on-chain hooks keep working. Fill it in and bump `schema` once an Arc indexer exists.
